newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Jordan's King Hussein visits Morocco, meets Hassan.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein visits Morocco, meets Hassan.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan arrived on Tuesday for a 24-hour visit expected to focus on the Middle East peace process, a Moroccan senior official said.

"Hussein's visit to Rabat is a part of the continuing consultations between Jordan and Morocco. He is expected to examine with his Majesty King Hassan the latest developments of the Middle East peace process," the official said.
King Hussein was greeted at his arrival at Rabat airport by the Moroccan monarch, his two sons and Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali. He did not speak to reporters.
Government officials said there was no formal agenda for the talks but they were expected to include peace in the Middle East and bilateral trade relations.
Jordan's king was accompanied by senior officials including Planning Minister Rima Khalaf. He is expected to leave Morocco on Wednesday, officials said.
